themes.note: Tokens are RGB triplets in app/globals.css: light on :root, dark on .dark (class set before hydration in app/layout.tsx). Frontmatter keys without a suffix are the .dark values; -light keys are the :root values. Component CSS uses rgb(var(--token)) so it follows the active theme.
themes.tailwindMapping: tailwind.config.ts maps bg, surface (+2), border (+strong), fg (+muted, subtle), on-fg, success, pending, danger, role-admin, role-collector, role-user (each +bg) and chart.1 to rgb(var(--x) / <alpha-value>).

kpi.purpose: The two KPI strip figures only (text-kpi).

title.purpose: Dialog titles; touch-size input text on phones (text-md).

body.purpose: Base size on body; dialog body (text-base).

body-dense.purpose: Table cells, panel titles, buttons, inputs, tabs, descriptions (text-sm).

label.purpose: Table headers, field labels, pills, small buttons, hints (text-xs). Sentence case.

shadows.name: sidebar-overlay
shadows.purpose: Sidebar only while hover-expanded over content.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and phone sheets, over a black 50% (dark: 70%) scrim.

shadows.name: segmented-thumb-edge
shadows.purpose: Inset hairline on the selected segmented tab; not elevation.

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring (danger at 15% when invalid).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for every tween, the sidebar width and the theme crossfade.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Layout moves: active nav pill, bottom-nav bar, segmented thumb, rows reflowing.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Empty states, nav items, KPI values, scrim.

motion.name: sheet
motion.value: y 100% to 0; 320ms in / 200ms out; drag-to-dismiss past 120px or 500px/s

motion.name: row
motion.value: in: opacity + y 4px, 220ms; out: opacity + x 24px, 180ms
motion.purpose: Rows entering; rows removed by approve, reject or remove.

motion.name: tab-switch
motion.value: opacity + x 12px in the direction of travel, 220ms; only after a user switch

motion.name: month-step
motion.value: label x 10px in the direction of travel; 200ms in / 120ms out

motion.name: number-tick
motion.value: 500ms requestAnimationFrame tween, exponential ease-out; no count-up on first render
motion.purpose: KPI totals and tab counts during the approval hand-off.

motion.name: sidebar
motion.value: width 64px to 232px over 240ms; hover intent 120ms open / 220ms close; labels fade in 200ms after 75ms, out in 100ms

motion.name: refetch-dim
motion.purpose: Previous page shown while the next loads (keepPreviousData).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: MotionConfig reducedMotion=user; CSS animation and transition durations 0.01ms
motion.purpose: Transforms dropped, opacity kept; number ticks jump to the value.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Tables switch between stacked rows and columns; dialogs are bottom sheets below it (PHONE_QUERY max-width 639px).

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar on; phone top bar and bottom nav off.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Page header on one row; row-level button labels shown.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled action; one per view (submit collection, sign in, new user).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(var(--fg)); color: rgb(var(--on-fg)); font: 500 0.8125rem/1.25rem var(--font-geist), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(var(--fg) / 0.85); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--fg) / 0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Prefixed Input
components.description: Labelled field with a fixed in-field prefix such as S- or PKR.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 160px; font-family: var(--font-geist), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(var(--fg-muted)); } .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input-prefix { position: absolute; left: 12px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(var(--fg-subtle)); pointer-events: none; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px 0 32px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--border-strong)); border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(var(--surface)); color: rgb(var(--fg)); font-size: 0.8125rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(var(--fg-subtle)); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--fg) / 0.25); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgb(var(--fg) / 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--fg) / 0.1); }

components.css: .ds-kpi { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(var(--surface)); font-family: var(--font-geist), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1; } .ds-kpi-cell { display: block; padding: 16px 20px; text-align: left; } .ds-kpi-button { border: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgb(var(--border)); background: none; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-kpi-button:hover { background: rgb(var(--surface-2) / 0.4); } .ds-kpi-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--fg) / 0.55); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-kpi-label { display: block; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: rgb(var(--fg-muted)); } .ds-kpi-value { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 2.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: rgb(var(--fg)); } .ds-kpi-value small { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; color: rgb(var(--fg-subtle)); } .ds-kpi-note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 20px; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgb(var(--fg-muted)); } .ds-kpi-note b { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(var(--fg)); }

narrative.overview:
The Collector is a monochrome ledger for a housing society's monthly dues. Everything is ink on a near-black ground (light theme: ink on near-white), drawn in hairlines, set in Geist with tabular figures so every column of rupees lines up. There is no brand accent. Colour appears only when it has a job: a payment's status, a person's role, a destructive action. The absence of colour is the brand; when green shows up, it means money has been approved.

Density is deliberate. Rows are 40px, body copy is 13-14px, panels sit edge to edge with 16px between them, and the KPI strip is one bordered panel split by a hairline rather than a grid of floating cards. The page reads like a ruled book: a title, a toolbar, a strip of two totals, and the queue.

Motion exists to show state changing, never to decorate. The system's signature is the approval hand-off: an approved row slides out of the Pending queue, the remaining rows glide up, the Pending count ticks down, and the month's Approved total ticks up. Every motion preset in the build serves that kind of change (selection, rows entering or leaving, dialogs, numbers moving, views switching).
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome ink-on-ground with no brand accent; both themes driven by the same RGB-triplet tokens.
Hairline-bordered panels as the single container; tonal steps instead of shadows at rest.
Geist throughout, tabular figures on by default, houses always `S-<n>`, amounts always `PKR 5,000`.
Colour reserved for jobs: status, role, destruction.
Dense, left-anchored tables that become stacked rows on phones.
Motion that only reports state change, with exponential ease-out and faster exits than entrances.

rules.name: The Colour-Has-A-Job Rule
rules.body: Every coloured pixel is a status, a role or a destructive action. There is no brand accent, no decorative tint, no raw Tailwind palette; components use only the token classes.

rules.name: The Green Means Approved Rule
rules.body: Green is reserved for Approved and grey for Pending. Nothing else may borrow either, including trend indicators: the month-over-month delta is written in neutral ink, with direction carried by an arrow and a sign.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every pill pairs its tint with a dot and a text label; colour is never the only carrier of status or role.

rules.name: The Reserved Indigo Rule
rules.body: `chart-1` belongs to future charts. Do not spend it on UI chrome.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular everywhere; numeric columns, counts and KPIs also carry `tabular-nums` explicitly so the alignment survives any override.

rules.name: The Fixed Formats Rule
rules.body: Houses are rendered `S-<n>` and amounts `PKR 5,000` through the shared formatters; never inline either format.

rules.name: The Ledger Alignment Rule
rules.body: Identifiers and names read left; short fixed-width tokens (relative time, status and role pills) sit centred; amounts and row actions sit right. Tables never centre text columns.

rules.name: The No Sideways Scroll Rule
rules.body: On phones a table row becomes a stacked mini-row (identifier and status top-left, amount top-right, secondary detail and actions below), never a horizontally scrolling table.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Panels, cards, buttons and inputs carry no shadow. A shadow means "this layer is temporarily above the page".

dos: Do use only the token colours (`bg`, `surface`, `fg`, `border`, `success`, `pending`, `danger`, `role-*`) and define every new token for both `:root` and `.dark` as RGB triplets.
Do keep green for Approved and grey for Pending; write trends and deltas in neutral ink with an arrow and a sign.
Do use violet for admin, sky for collector and amber for user, and only inside the role pill.
Do spend one ink-filled primary button per view; everything else is secondary or ghost.
Do put content in panels (8px radius, hairline border, surface fill) and keep panels one level deep.
Do align identifiers and names left, relative times and pills centre, amounts and row actions right.
Do use the shared motion presets: exponential ease-out `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, the 500/40 spring for layout moves, exits faster than entrances, and reduced motion honoured.
Do show loading with skeletons shaped like the content, and write empty states that say what will appear and what to do.
Do keep collector inputs and submit buttons at 44px on phones.
donts: Don't introduce a brand accent or use raw Tailwind palettes (zinc, blue, etc.).
Don't use green, grey-pill styling or role colours for anything other than status and role.
Don't use danger red outside destructive actions and invalid input.
Don't use `chart-1` until the charts ship.
Don't nest panels or build floating KPI cards; the KPI strip is one panel split by a hairline.
Don't centre text columns in tables or let tables scroll sideways on phones.
Don't animate for decoration: no count-up on page load, no ambient loops, no entrance flourishes beyond the route settle.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces.
Don't convey status or role by colour alone.
